what_it_is: India's self-serve in-cab advertising network that runs silent digital screens on headrest tablets in airport and city cabs across Mumbai, Delhi NCR, Bengaluru and other Indian cities.
who_for: Brands and agencies seeking to reach captive passengers in Indian cities, and fleet owners or drivers who can earn from referring campaigns.

claims.text: Backseat Network is India's self-serve in-cab advertising network with silent passenger screens in airport cabs and city fleets across Mumbai, Delhi NCR, Bengaluru and beyond.
claims.evidence: Backseat Network is India's self-serve in-cab advertising network. Silent passenger screens run in airport cabs and city fleets in Mumbai, Delhi NCR, Bengaluru and beyond

claims.text: Advertising starts at ₹4,000 per cab per month plus GST, payable by UPI or card through the platform.
claims.evidence: Backseat Network is India's self-serve in-cab advertising network. Silent passenger screens run in airport cabs and city fleets in Mumbai, Delhi NCR, Bengaluru and beyond, from ₹4,000 per cab per month plus GST, paid by UPI or car

claims.text: Campaigns can be booked from a single cab for one month with a minimum spend of ₹4,000 plus GST.
claims.evidence: You can book from a single cab for one month (₹4,000 plus GST). Add cabs and months for more reach; the pricing calculator shows the total as you go.

claims.text: GST at 18% is added on the invoice and emailed automatically after payment.
claims.evidence: One price in every city. GST at 18% is added on the invoice, which is emailed as soon as you pay.

claims.text: Estimated total cost including GST for a Mumbai campaign is ₹1,41,600 covering 10 vehicles for 3 months.
Each passenger watches the ad for 20 to 45 minutes with no skip button and the creative carries a QR code they can scan before the ride ends.
claims.evidence: Taxi advertising your customer watches for 20 to 45 minutes Your ad plays on a headrest tablet at eye level. There is no skip button, and every creative carries a QR code the passenger can scan before the ride ends.

claims.text: Ad plays are counted and tracked live by GPS map showing where cabs carrying the ad are running.
claims.evidence: Every play is counted, a live GPS map shows the cabs carrying your ad, and QR scans land in your own analytics.

claims.text: QR codes on every ad allow passengers to scan and the scans land in the advertiser's own analytics through a tagged link.
claims.evidence: Put a UTM-tagged link in your QR code and every scan shows up in Google Analytics or your own tools.

claims.text: Campaign launch happens in 4 steps: Brief Vira, Review the creative, Pick cabs and months, Pay and go live.
claims.evidence: Most online advertising platforms stop at the phone screen. This one books real cabs, with the same card-and-UPI checkout. Brief Vira Review the creative Pick cabs and months Pay and go live

claims.text: Advertisers can pick cities including Mumbai, Delhi NCR, Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Chennai and Pune where cabs are live or onboarding.
claims.evidence: Which Indian cities can I buy? Mumbai, Delhi NCR and Bengaluru are live. Hyderabad, Chennai and Pune are onboarding, with more cities to follow.

claims.text: Real testimonials show passengers watching one silent loop, opening the site from the QR and later typing the brand into search, demonstrating real brand search lift.
